title: Warboys home with indoor pool and leisure facilities for sale at over £700,000
content: A four-bedroom property in Warboys with an indoor swimming pool is up for sale at offers over £700,000. Regent House is a semi-detached property with outbuildings housing the pool, a gym and other recreational facilities. Selling agent Fine & Country said the “characterful and beautifully presented period home” is set in just under half an acre. Entering the property, the porch opens to the entrance hall, which leads to the main reception rooms and the rear hallway. The sitting room features bespoke cabinetry either side of the chimney breast, which has an oak mantel and wood-burning stove. There's a wood-burning stove in the sitting room (Image: Fine & Country) There's a large inglenook fireplace in the panelled dining room (Image: Fine & Country) In the panelled formal dining room, there’s a large inglenook fireplace. The recently refitted kitchen features a range cooker and bespoke cabinetry (Image: Fine & Country) The rear hallway gives access to the recently refitted kitchen, which features bespoke cabinetry, quartz worksurfaces, integrated appliances including a Bertazzoni range cooker, a Quooker tap and a wine chiller.
